output.final_rationale: The verdict does not change because no genuinely new admissible evidence was introduced. The Actor narrowed the claim and made useful concessions, but that is a reframing of the same record, not new support for the defended action. Under the stated policy, named customer commitments and pending legal review are unresolved materiality predicates.
